changedFiles.reason: New finalization seam for finalized-entry validation, idempotent archive append calls, and safe process-history bridging.

Covers Story 2 finalization boundary cases: delta exclusion, interrupted exclusion, incomplete tool-result rejection, exact-once append, retry idempotency, and safe compatibility mapping.
